verdict.rationale: First-party NVIDIA docs cover the full DLSS stack on RTX 50 Series: Super Resolution, DLAA, Ray Reconstruction, Frame Generation, and Multi Frame Generation (up to five generated frames per rendered frame, with a dynamic multiplier). They also claim broad game support, stating the NVIDIA app can update hundreds of games to the latest DLSS features. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of DLSS/MFG performance and game coverage on the 5070 Ti specifically (the only community review covers cooling, noise and price).
